```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Problem 1: Birthday problem
```{r}
birthday_repeated = function(n) {
  birthdays = sample(1:365, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  length(unique(birthdays)) < n
}
```

```{r}
birthday_results_df =
  crossing(
    number_of_people = 2:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |>
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )
```

```{r}
birthday_results_df |>
  group_by(number_of_people) |>
  summarize(
    prob_of_repeat = mean(repeated)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeat)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Probability of Shared Birthdays",
    x = "Number of People",
    y = "Probability of at Least One Shared Birthday"
  )
```

# Problem 2: Spaghetti plot
```{r}
unzip("hw5_data.zip", exdir = "hw5_data")
```

Create a dataframe containing all file names
```{r}
file_names <- list.files(
  "hw5_data/data",
  full.names = TRUE
)

study_df <- tibble(
  file_name = file_names
)
```

Read each participant's data
```{r}
study_df = study_df |>
  mutate(
    data = map(file_name, read_csv)
  )
```
Tidy the dataframe
```{r}
tidy_df <- study_df |>
  unnest(data) |>
  mutate(
    file_name = str_remove(basename(file_name), ".csv"),
    arm = str_sub(file_name, 1, 3),
    subject_id = file_name
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    week_1:week_8,
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "observation",
    names_prefix = "week_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = as.numeric(week),
    arm = recode(
      arm,
      con = "control",
      exp = "experimental"
    )
  ) |>
  select(subject_id, arm, week, observation)
```

Create a spaghetti plot
```{r}
tidy_df |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = week,
      y = observation,
      group = subject_id,
      color = arm
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path() +
  facet_grid(~arm) +
  labs(
    title = "Observations Over Time by Study Arm",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Observation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
